title: Frontend: Registration page with form validation
description: Build the registration page with a form for name, email, and password. Show inline validation errors. On success, redirect to dashboard.
acceptanceCriteria: Form has: name, email, password fields
Inline validation: email format, password min 8 chars
Submit button shows loading spinner during API call
API error (e.g., email taken) displayed below form
On success: stores auth state, redirects to /dashboard
OAuth buttons: 'Continue with Google' and 'Continue with GitHub'

steps.description: Create RegisterPage with React Hook Form + Zod
steps.details: Create src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx. Use useForm with zodResolver. Schema: { name: string.min(1), email: string.email(), password: string.min(8) }. Use shadcn/ui Form, FormField, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormMessage components for consistent error display.

steps.description: Connect to API and handle response
steps.details: On submit, call POST /api/auth/register. On success: call authStore.setAuth(user, accessToken), navigate('/dashboard'). On API error: display error message from response body below the form.

Add 'Continue with Google' and 'Continue with GitHub' buttons. On click, navigate to /api/auth/google or /api/auth/github (these redirect to OAuth providers). Handle /auth/callback route to capture the token from query params.

Open /register. Try submitting empty form — verify validation errors. Submit with short password — verify error. Submit valid data — verify redirect to dashboard. Try duplicate email — verify error message.

technicalNotes: Install react-hook-form and @hookform/resolvers: npm install react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod
